Paragraph: "Intellectuals of your kind, who have conquered anger and senses are to be seen by the chief of monkeys Sugreeva, for your advent is godsend...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Reassuring Lakshmana and validating the high character of the princes.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuman praises their self-control and declares their arrival a blessing.
Outcome/Resolution: Provides immediate emotional reassurance and hope.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Reassurance, calming words to ease distress

Brief_Summary_Psychological: Providing empathetic validation and positive reappraisal to reduce distress and build hope.
